scripts.payments:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,mp_order_id,status,amount_cents,created_at,approved_at FROM payments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;"
scripts.attempts:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,device_id,mac,attempt_number,status,router_started_at,starts_at,ends_at FROM access_attempts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;"
scripts.codes:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT code,mode,status,duration_seconds,is_permanent,uses,max_uses,redeemed_at FROM access_codes ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30;"
scripts.groups:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,code,max_devices,phone_e164,expires_at,created_at FROM party_groups ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;"
scripts.audit:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT action,created_at,details_json FROM admin_audit ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;"
scripts.users:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT d.id,d.hostname,d.payer_email,d.phone_e164,MAX(CASE WHEN ag.status='active' THEN ag.ends_at END) AS active_until FROM devices d LEFT JOIN access_grants ag ON ag.device_id=d.id GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC LIMIT 50;"
scripts.report:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,name,starts_at,ends_at,status FROM events ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;"
scripts.team:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT username,display_name,role,enabled,last_login_at FROM admin_accounts ORDER BY created_at DESC;"
scripts.privacy:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT site_id,device_id,policy_version,accepted_at FROM privacy_acceptances ORDER BY accepted_at DESC LIMIT 20;"
scripts.routers:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,name,identity,board,version,install_mode,install_status,last_seen_at FROM router_devices ORDER BY created_at DESC;"
scripts.enrollments:check: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command="SELECT id,router_name,install_mode,expires_at,used_at,router_id FROM router_enrollments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30;"
